raw_text: UPI payments down across India. SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis all showing transaction failures. Multiple users reporting payment timeouts since early morning. This looks like a coordinated infrastructure issue, not individual bank problems. Monitoring the situation. #UPIDown #PaymentFailure #NPCI
clean_text: UPI payments down across India with transaction failures at SBI, HDFC, ICICI, and Axis banks. Appears to be coordinated infrastructure issue affecting NPCI.
